description: Verify that DUT actually uses the ARP cache entry learned from a tester ARP Request — when DUT later sends a UDP datagram to the same IP, the Ethernet destination MAC must equal the learned value (RFC 826 §2.3, end-to-end check)
approach:
[Objective]
This is the end-to-end companion to ARP_03. ARP_03 only checks that DUT does not emit its own ARP Request; ARP_04 additionally verifies that the UDP datagram DUT sends actually carries the learned MAC as its Ethernet destination — so cache learning is observed both as 'no extra resolution' and as 'the cached value was actually consumed'.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ARP Request injected
   • sender IP  = HOST-1-IP (tester's IP)
   • sender MAC = MAC-ADDR1 (tester's MAC)
   • target IP  = DUT IP
   ⇒ DUT must add <HOST-1-IP, MAC-ADDR1> to its ARP cache.

2. Tester → DUT: SOME/IP Subscribe-Nack message
   ⇒ Stimulates DUT to send a UDP response back to HOST-1-IP.

3. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: UDP packet
      - destination MAC = MAC-ADDR1 (the learned value)   ← key check
   • DUT must NOT emit its own ARP Request before the UDP

[Pass condition]
Within the observation window, DUT (a) emits the UDP, (b) its destination MAC equals MAC-ADDR1 from step 1, and (c) no DUT-originated ARP Request precedes it.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_dut_did_arp_request — DUT emitted its own ARP Request (cache learning failed; the entry was not retained)
• Fail_wrong_eth_dst — UDP was sent but the Ethernet destination MAC differs from MAC-ADDR1 (cache entry was not consumed; DUT may have used a stale or default address)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the observation window

verdicts.Pass: DUT sent UDP using the cached MAC and skipped a redundant ARP Request — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_did_arp_request: DUT emitted its own ARP Request after learning — cache entry was not retained
verdicts.Fail_wrong_eth_dst: UDP was sent but its Ethernet destination did not match the learned MAC — cached entry not actually used
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit UDP within the observation window — stimulus did not provoke egress
